commands.name: HardDeleteTask
steps: inside UoW rerun complete local/cross-domain guards and exact dependency set

for a WFM Task require creation_origin=wfm_manual, no accepted source projection/evidence, no reassignment, execution, outcome, Objective membership, retry, lineage, explicit lock or other protected history, and exactly one registration-baseline wfm_rfc_assignment_events row whose prior_rfc_id is null, new_rfc_id equals current_rfc_id and command_id equals wfm_task_identities.created_command_id

delete only previewed eligible current draft relationships/plan rows; for an eligible source-free manual-WFM draft delete its sole registration-baseline assignment event and WFM identity; then delete the Task row in FK-safe order
append minimal deletion audit/result refs and commit
rules: audit remains append-only; deletion is correction, not lifecycle/history purge

the registration-baseline WFM assignment event is the only assignment-history deletion exception and exists solely to make the explicitly eligible untouched source-free manual-WFM draft removable; any second assignment event or reassignment history blocks hard deletion
source-adopted WFM or any Task with protected operational/history evidence is never made eligible by deleting evidence

pure_preview_authority: TaskHardDeletePreview is defined in queries/objectives-tasks.json. It is side-effect-free and creates no command receipt, revision, audit event or external effect.
